''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''

If ``send()`` is called on a closed connection the server should raise
a server-specific subclass of ``OSError``. This is not guaranteed, however,
especially on older ASGI server implementations (it was introduced in spec
version 2.4).

Applications may catch this exception and do cleanup work before
re-raising it or returning with no exception.

Servers must be prepared to catch this exception if they raised it and
should not log it as an error in their server logs.


Disconnect - ``receive`` event
''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''

Sent to the application if receive is called after a response has been
sent or after the HTTP connection has been closed. This is mainly useful
for long-polling, where you may want to trigger cleanup code if the
connection closes early.

Once you have received this event, you should expect future calls to ``send()``
to raise an exception, as described above. However, if you have highly
concurrent code, you may find calls to ``send()`` erroring slightly before you
receive this event.

Keys:

* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``"http.disconnect"``.


WebSocket
---------

WebSockets share some HTTP details - they have a path and headers - but also
have more state. Again, most of that state is in the ``scope``, which will live
as long as the socket does.

WebSocket protocol servers should handle PING/PONG messages themselves, and
send PING messages as necessary to ensure the connection is alive.

WebSocket protocol servers should handle message fragmentation themselves,
and deliver complete messages to the application.

The WebSocket protocol should be signified to ASGI applications with
a ``type`` value of ``websocket``.


Websocket Connection Scope
''''''''''''''''''''''''''

WebSocket connections' scope lives as long as the socket itself - if the
application dies the socket should be closed, and vice-versa.

The *connection scope* information passed in ``scope`` contains initial connection
metadata (mostly from the HTTP request line and headers):

* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``"websocket"``.

* ``asgi["version"]`` (*Unicode string*) -- The version of the ASGI spec.

* ``asgi["spec_version"]`` (*Unicode string*) -- Version of the ASGI
  HTTP spec this server understands; one of ``"2.0"``, ``"2.1"``, ``"2.2"`` or
  ``"2.3"``. Optional; if missing assume ``"2.0"``.

* ``http_version`` (*Unicode string*) -- One of ``"1.1"`` or
  ``"2"``. Optional; if missing default is ``"1.1"``.

* ``scheme`` (*Unicode string*) -- URL scheme portion (likely ``"ws"`` or
  ``"wss"``). Optional (but must not be empty); default is ``"ws"``.

* ``path`` (*Unicode string*) -- HTTP request target excluding any query
  string, with percent-encoded sequences and UTF-8 byte sequences
  decoded into characters.

* ``raw_path`` (*byte string*) -- The original HTTP path component,
  excluding any query string, unmodified from the bytes that were
  received by the web server. Some web server implementations may
  be unable to provide this. Optional; if missing defaults to ``None``.

* ``query_string`` (*byte string*) -- URL portion after the
  ``?``. Optional; if missing or ``None`` default is empty string.

* ``root_path`` (*Unicode string*) -- The root path this application is
  mounted at; same as ``SCRIPT_NAME`` in WSGI. Optional; if missing
  defaults to empty string.

* ``headers`` (*Iterable[[byte string, byte string]]*) -- An iterable of
  ``[name, value]`` two-item iterables, where ``name`` is the header name and
  ``value`` is the header value. Order should be preserved from the original
  HTTP request; duplicates are possible and must be preserved in the message
  as received. Header names should be lowercased, but it is not required;
  servers should preserve header case on a best-effort basis.
  Pseudo headers (present in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3) must be removed;
  if ``:authority`` is present its value must be added to the
  start of the iterable with ``host`` as the header name
  or replace any existing host header already present.

* ``client`` (*Iterable[Unicode string, int]*) -- A two-item iterable
  of ``[host, port]``, where ``host`` is the remote host's IPv4 or
  IPv6 address, and ``port`` is the remote port. Optional; if missing
  defaults to ``None``.

* ``server`` (*Iterable[Unicode string, Optional[int]]*) -- Either a
  two-item iterable of ``[host, port]``, where ``host`` is the
  listening address for this server, and ``port`` is the integer
  listening port, or ``[path, None]`` where ``path`` is that of the
  unix socket. Optional; if missing defaults to ``None``.

* ``subprotocols`` (*Iterable[Unicode string]*) -- Subprotocols the
  client advertised. Optional; if missing defaults to empty list.

* ``state`` Optional(*dict[Unicode string, Any]*) -- A copy of the
  namespace passed into the lifespan corresponding to this request. (See :doc:`lifespan`).
  Optional; if missing the server does not support this feature.


Connect - ``receive`` event
'''''''''''''''''''''''''''

Sent to the application when the client initially opens a connection and is about
to finish the WebSocket handshake.

This message must be responded to with either an *Accept* message
or a *Close* message before the socket will pass ``websocket.receive``
messages. The protocol server must send this message
during the handshake phase of the WebSocket and not complete the handshake
until it gets a reply, returning HTTP status code ``403`` if the connection is
denied.

Keys:

* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``"websocket.connect"``.


Accept - ``send`` event
'''''''''''''''''''''''

Sent by the application when it wishes to accept an incoming connection.

* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``"websocket.accept"``.

* ``subprotocol`` (*Unicode string*) -- The subprotocol the server
  wishes to accept. Optional; if missing defaults to ``None``.

* ``headers`` (*Iterable[[byte string, byte string]]*) -- An iterable
  of ``[name, value]`` two-item iterables, where ``name`` is the
  header name, and ``value`` is the header value. Order must be
  preserved in the HTTP response.  Header names must be
  lowercased. Must not include a header named
  ``sec-websocket-protocol``; use the ``subprotocol`` key
  instead. Optional; if missing defaults to an empty list. *Added in
  spec version 2.1*. Pseudo headers (present in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3)
  must not be present.


Receive - ``receive`` event
'''''''''''''''''''''''''''

Sent to the application when a data message is received from the client.

Keys:

* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``"websocket.receive"``.

* ``bytes`` (*byte string*) -- The message content, if it was binary
  mode, or ``None``. Optional; if missing, it is equivalent to
  ``None``.

* ``text`` (*Unicode string*) -- The message content, if it was text
  mode, or ``None``. Optional; if missing, it is equivalent to
  ``None``.

Exactly one of ``bytes`` or ``text`` must be non-``None``. One or both
keys may be present, however.


Send - ``send`` event
'''''''''''''''''''''

Sent by the application to send a data message to the client.

Keys:

* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``"websocket.send"``.

* ``bytes`` (*byte string*) -- Binary message content, or ``None``.
   Optional; if missing, it is equivalent to ``None``.

* ``text`` (*Unicode string*) -- Text message content, or ``None``.
   Optional; if missing, it is equivalent to ``None``.

Exactly one of ``bytes`` or ``text`` must be non-``None``. One or both
keys may be present, however.


.. _disconnect-receive-event-ws:

Disconnect - ``receive`` event
''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''

Sent to the application when either connection to the client is lost, either from
the client closing the connection, the server closing the connection, or loss of the
socket.

Once you have received this event, you should expect future calls to ``send()``
to raise an exception, as described below. However, if you have highly
concurrent code, you may find calls to ``send()`` erroring slightly before you
receive this event.

Keys:

* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``"websocket.disconnect"``

* ``code`` (*int*) -- The WebSocket close code, as per the WebSocket spec. If no code
  was received in the frame from the client, the server should set this to ``1005``
  (the default value in the WebSocket specification).

* ``reason`` (*Unicode string*) -- A reason given for the disconnect, can
  be any string. Optional; if missing or ``None`` default is empty
  string.


Disconnected Client - ``send`` exception
''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''

If ``send()`` is called on a closed connection the server should raise
a server-specific subclass of ``OSError``. This is not guaranteed, however,
especially on older ASGI server implementations (it was introduced in spec
version 2.4).

Applications may catch this exception and do cleanup work before
re-raising it or returning with no exception.

Servers must be prepared to catch this exception if they raised it and
should not log it as an error in their server logs.


Close - ``send`` event
''''''''''''''''''''''

Sent by the application to tell the server to close the connection.

If this is sent before the socket is accepted, the server
must close the connection with a HTTP 403 error code
(Forbidden), and not complete the WebSocket handshake; this may present on some
browsers as a different WebSocket error code (such as 1006, Abnormal Closure).

If this is sent after the socket is accepted, the server must close the socket
with the close code passed in the message (or 1000 if none is specified).

* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``"websocket.close"``.

* ``code`` (*int*) -- The WebSocket close code, as per the WebSocket
  spec.  Optional; if missing defaults to ``1000``.

* ``reason`` (*Unicode string*) -- A reason given for the closure, can
  be any string. Optional; if missing or ``None`` default is empty
  string.


WSGI Compatibility
------------------

Part of the design of the HTTP portion of this spec is to make sure it
aligns well with the WSGI specification, to ensure easy adaptability
between both specifications and the ability to keep using WSGI
applications with ASGI servers.

WSGI applications, being synchronous, must be run in a threadpool in order
to be served, but otherwise their runtime maps onto the HTTP connection scope's
lifetime.

There is an almost direct mapping for the various special keys in
WSGI's ``environ`` variable to the ``http`` scope:

* ``REQUEST_METHOD`` is the ``method``
* ``SCRIPT_NAME`` is ``root_path``
* ``PATH_INFO`` can be derived by stripping ``root_path`` from ``path``
* ``QUERY_STRING`` is ``query_string``
* ``CONTENT_TYPE`` can be extracted from ``headers``
* ``CONTENT_LENGTH`` can be extracted from ``headers``
* ``SERVER_NAME`` and ``SERVER_PORT`` are in ``server``
* ``REMOTE_HOST``/``REMOTE_ADDR`` and ``REMOTE_PORT`` are in ``client``
* ``SERVER_PROTOCOL`` is encoded in ``http_version``
* ``wsgi.url_scheme`` is ``scheme``
* ``wsgi.input`` is a ``StringIO`` based around the ``http.request`` messages
* ``wsgi.errors`` is directed by the wrapper as needed

The ``start_response`` callable maps similarly to ``http.response.start``:

* The ``status`` argument becomes ``status``, with the reason phrase dropped.
* ``response_headers`` maps to ``headers``

Yielding content from the WSGI application maps to sending
``http.response.body`` messages.


WSGI encoding differences
-------------------------

The WSGI specification (as defined in PEP 3333) specifies that all strings
sent to or from the server must be of the ``str`` type but only contain
codepoints in the ISO-8859-1 ("latin-1") range. This was due to it originally
being designed for Python 2 and its different set of string types.

The ASGI HTTP and WebSocket specifications instead specify each entry of the
``scope`` dict as either a byte string or a Unicode string. HTTP, being an
older protocol, is sometimes imperfect at specifying encoding, so some
decisions of what is Unicode versus bytes may not be obvious.

* ``path``: URLs can have both percent-encoded and UTF-8 encoded sections.
  Because decoding these is often done by the underlying server (or sometimes
  even proxies in the path), this is a Unicode string, fully decoded from both
  UTF-8 encoding and percent encodings.

* ``headers``: These are byte strings of the exact byte sequences sent by the
  client/to be sent by the server. While modern HTTP standards say that headers
  should be ASCII, older ones did not and allowed a wider range of characters.
  Frameworks/applications should decode headers as they deem appropriate.

* ``query_string``: Unlike the ``path``, this is not as subject to server
  interference and so is presented as its raw byte string version,
  percent-encoded.

* ``root_path``: Unicode string to match ``path``.


Version History
---------------


* 2.0 (2017-11-28): Initial non-channel-layer based ASGI spec

import sys

class StopStream:
    def __init__(self, stops, include_stop=False):
        self.stops = [s for s in stops]
        if not self.stops:
            raise ValueError('at least one stop')
        self.include_stop = include_stop
        self.candidate = bytearray()
        self.released = 0
        self.stopped = False
        self.finish_reason = None
        self.stop_string = None

    def _earliest(self):
        best = None
        for s in self.stops:
            p = self.candidate.find(s)
            if p < 0:
                continue
            key = (p, -len(s), bytes(s))
            if best is None or key < best[0]:
                best = (key, p, s)
        return best

    def _release_to(self, limit):
        if limit <= self.released:
            return ''
        n = limit
        while n > self.released:
            try:
                self.candidate[:n].decode('utf-8')
                break
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                n -= 1
        if n <= self.released:
            return ''
        text = bytes(self.candidate[self.released:n]).decode('utf-8')
        self.released = n
        return text

    def _keep_len(self):
        keep = 0
        m = len(self.candidate)
        for s in self.stops:
            top = min(len(s) - 1, m)
            for k in range(top, 0, -1):
                if self.candidate.endswith(s[:k]):
                    if k > keep:
                        keep = k
                    break
        return keep

    def feed(self, piece):
        if self.stopped:
            return ''
        if not isinstance(piece, (bytes, bytearray)):
            raise TypeError('piece must be bytes')
        self.candidate.extend(piece)
        hit = self._earliest()
        if hit is not None:
            _, p, s = hit
            end = p + len(s) if self.include_stop else p
            text = self._release_to(end)
            self.stopped = True
            self.finish_reason = 'stop'
            self.stop_string = bytes(s).decode('utf-8')
            return text
        keep = self._keep_len()
        return self._release_to(len(self.candidate) - keep)

    def finish(self):
        if self.stopped:
            return ''
        text = self._release_to(len(self.candidate))
        if self.released < len(self.candidate):
            raise ValueError('incomplete utf-8 at finish')
        self.stopped = True
        self.finish_reason = 'eos'
        self.stop_string = None
        return text

import sys

class StopStream:
    def __init__(self, stops, include_stop=False):
        self.stops = [s for s in stops]
        if not self.stops:
            raise ValueError('at least one stop')
        self.include_stop = include_stop
        self.candidate = bytearray()
        self.released = 0
        self.stopped = False
        self.finish_reason = None
        self.stop_string = None

    def _earliest(self):
        best = None
        for s in self.stops:
            p = self.candidate.find(s)
            if p < 0:
                continue
            key = (p, -len(s), bytes(s))
            if best is None or key < best[0]:
                best = (key, p, s)
        return best

    def _release_to(self, limit):
        if limit <= self.released:
            return ''
        n = limit
        while n > self.released:
            try:
                self.candidate[:n].decode('utf-8')
                break
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                n -= 1
        if n <= self.released:
            return ''
        text = bytes(self.candidate[self.released:n]).decode('utf-8')
        self.released = n
        return text

    def _keep_len(self):
        keep = 0
        m = len(self.candidate)
        for s in self.stops:
            top = min(len(s) - 1, m)
            for k in range(top, 0, -1):
                if self.candidate.endswith(s[:k]):
                    if k > keep:
                        keep = k
                    break
        return keep

    def feed(self, piece):
        if self.stopped:
            return ''
        if not isinstance(piece, (bytes, bytearray)):
            raise TypeError('piece must be bytes')
        self.candidate.extend(piece)
        hit = self._earliest()
        if hit is not None:
            _, p, s = hit
            end = p + len(s) if self.include_stop else p
            text = self._release_to(end)
            self.stopped = True
            self.finish_reason = 'stop'
            self.stop_string = bytes(s).decode('utf-8')
            return text
        keep = self._keep_len()
        return self._release_to(len(self.candidate) - keep)

    def finish(self):
        if self.stopped:
            return ''
        text = self._release_to(len(self.candidate))
        if self.released < len(self.candidate):
            raise ValueError('incomplete utf-8 at finish')
        self.stopped = True
        self.finish_reason = 'eos'
        self.stop_string = None
        return text

{"chapter":"# K-SYS-007：输入输出语义：Tokenizer、Chat Template 与流式文本

模型消费的不是屏幕上的字符串，而是一条由模板、规范化、分词和特殊 token 策略共同决定的整数序列；输出也要经过 token 字节映射、流式边界和停止协议才能成为用户看到的文本。服务必须把输入输出链当作模型函数的一部分，不能把它只当作展示层细节。

设消息序列为 M，模板及其版本为 T，tokenizer/processor 制品为 K，截断策略为 τ，则规范化模型输入可写为：

I(M; T, K, τ) = Trunc_τ(Tokenize_K(Render_T(M, flags), special_policy), unit)

这里 Render 产出的可能是文本，也可能已经是带控制 token 的字节或 token 片段；Tokenize 的规范化、特殊 token 和词表映射由 K 决定；Trunc 必须记录截断单位、截断侧和被删除范围。I 才是模型实际消费的输入。两个字符串看起来相同、长度相同或来自同一个 UI 会话，都不足以证明 I 相同。

输入构造至少要保存以下状态：模板版本、tokenizer/processor 版本、规范化配置、特殊 token 表、词表大小、truncation 记录、有效 token 数 n、物理张量宽度 L_pad、attention mask、位置规则给出的 positions，以及已消费并已产生有效模型状态的长度 cache_len。n 是逻辑有效长度，L_pad 只是执行形状；cache_len 不能由 padding 后的列数猜测，也不能因为请求中出现过某个 token 就自动增加。

输出侧至少区分三类对象：模型采样出的 token ID 序列、decoder 产出的文本字节或字符、服务协议已经提交给客户端的内容。暂停、取消、停止字符串或发送失败都可能让三者不同步。usage 和 finish reason 应分别说明其计数单位，避免把已采样、已解码、已交付混成一个数。

本章要求以下不变量成立：模板插入的特殊 token 与 tokenizer 自动添加的特殊 token 不得因配置错误而重复；padding 位置不进入 attention 有效集合，也不推进 cache；截断必须留下可审计记录；输出文本必须能由固定 tokenizer 和 decoder 重建；协议规定不展示停止字符串时，任何可能成为其前缀的后缀不得先发给用户。

## 合法输入与状态边界

### 模板不是普通字符串拼接

Chat template 将角色、消息内容和控制 token 变成模型训练时见过的序列。[S-CHAT](../sources/S-CHAT.md) 说明，不同模型即使来自同一底座，也可能使用不同的角色边界和回合终止标记；使用错误控制 token 会改变模型输入。模板文本的具体形式是模型制品合同，不是可以任意替换的格式。

模板需要区分两类消息：已经完成的历史消息，以及为了开始新回复而加入的生成提示。`add_generation_prompt` 表示加入 assistant 回合的起始标记；`continue_final_message` 表示继续最后一条消息，通常用于预填 assistant 回复。来源文档明确说明二者不应同时使用：前者开始新消息，后者移除末尾终止 token，混用会产生冲突。本章把它们当作互斥的输入选项，而不是两个可以随意叠加的性能开关。

工具调用、多模态 placeholder 和连续 assistant 消息还可能引入专门结构。角色、工具调用身份、参数序列化和结果顺序都是模型输入的一部分。应用层把一个对象格式化成 JSON 文本时，键顺序、空格和转义方式可能改变 token 序列；业务上表示同一个对象，不等价于模型看到同一输入。

### 特殊 token 与用户内容

模板应当把角色和结构控制与用户内容分开。用户内容里出现看起来像控制 token 的字符串时，系统必须按 tokenizer 的合同决定它是普通文本还是保留的特殊 token，不能让字符串插值悄悄改变消息边界。

[S-CHAT](../sources/S-CHAT.md) 还说明，某些 tokenizer 会自动添加 BOS/EOS；模板通常已经包含必要的特殊 token。若先调用 `apply_chat_template(tokenize=False)` 得到文本，再单独 tokenize，就应禁用自动特殊 token，否则可能重复添加。若模板直接以 tokenize 方式产出序列，则应由该接口统一处理。两种路径都能合法，前提是最终 ids 中特殊 token 的出现次数符合模型合同。

词表大小、embedding 行数和输出 head 的维度也必须一致。两套 tokenizer 都能产生合法整数 ID，不代表它们对同一文本产生相同模型输入；输出 decoder 也不能与另一版本的词表混用。

### Unicode 规范化与增量边界

Unicode 看起来相同的字符串可能有不同码点或字节，例如组合字符与预组合字符。是否存在统一 NFC、NFD 或其他规范化，取决于 tokenizer 的训练和推理合同，不存在适用于所有模型的通用规范化选择。服务可以用规范表示做比较，但必须先从制品得到该表示，不能凭 UI 字符串直接下结论。

对新增文本片段单独分词再拼接，也不一定等于对完整文本分词。BPE 合并可能跨越片段边界，normalization 也可能需要上下文。只有 tokenizer 明确提供稳定前缀契约，或实际检查证明旧 token 前缀在新文本下保持不变时，才可以复用已分词前缀。没有这个证明时，合法路径是保存原始文本并从最后一个稳定边界重做，或者等输入完整后再分词。

### 截断、padding 与 cache

截断是任务语义选择，不是纯性能细节。丢开头可能丢系统指令，丢尾部可能丢用户问题。截断预算的计量单位必须明确：字节、Unicode 字符、token、图像 patch 和音频采样点不能混用。模型最大上下文与服务资源预算也不是同一个数；服务可以在模型上限内因内存或时延主动拒绝或缩短。

设一批原始有效长度为 n₁ 和 n₂，统一 padding 到 L_pad。右 padding 时有效行位于前缀，左 padding 时有效行整体后移。无论采用哪一种，抽取末行 logits 都应使用 mask 中最后一个有效位置，而不是无条件读取最后一列。设有效长度为 1、3，右 padding 到 3，则两个样本的末行索引分别是 0 和 2；左 padding 的一个样本可能有效位置只有索引 2。cache 追加也只应消费有效 token，padding 不写 KV，不推进有效位置。

位置编码规则由模型决定。截断或 padding 后的 positions 不是原始字符串的字符偏移；对于多模态输入，还可能包含时间、高度和宽度坐标。逻辑位置、模型位置和物理槽位是三种不同对象。

## 输入构造算法

下面的算法把模板、特殊 token、截断和 mask 放在同一条可检查路径中。它不规定具体模型的模板文本，也不规定某种 tokenizer 的内部合并表。

```pseudocode
ALGORITHM BuildModelInput
输入：消息 M、制品 A、模板选项 f、输入预算 b
输出：有效 ids、mask、positions、removed_spans、失败原因
1. 核对 M 的角色、顺序、内容类型和工具/模态引用；记录 A 的模板与 tokenizer 版本
2. 若 f.add_generation_prompt 与 f.continue_final_message 同时为真，返回 FAILED_CONFLICT
3. X ← RenderBytes(A.template, M, f)
4. 根据 A.tokenizer 的规范化、预分词和特殊 token 策略生成 ids
   若 X 已由模板插入控制 token，且随后单独调用 tokenizer，则禁用自动特殊 token
   否则按制品合同只插入该插入的 BOS/EOS
5. ids ← Tokenize(X, A.tokenizer, special_policy)
6. 检查每个 id 在词表范围内；如有需要，记录 token 到 X 的字节偏移
7. 按已声明单位和侧执行 truncation，得到 ids_eff 与 removed_spans
   若预算不足且任务不允许截断，返回 FAILED_TOO_LONG
8. n ← |ids_eff|；mask 只把 n 个有效位置标为一；物理 padding 不进入有效集合
9. positions ← PositionRule(A.model, ids_eff, X 的模态元数据)
10. 若本请求从缓存恢复，只接受由完整状态证明给出的 cache_len；否则 cache_len ← 0
11. 返回 ids_eff、mask、positions、n、removed_spans
```

正确性检查不能只比较渲染后的可见字符串。应比较 ids 的长度、特殊 token 的出现位置、用户内容到 token 的偏移、截断后的前缀/后缀，以及恢复时 cache_len 是否等于已提交的有效 token 数。若模板版本、tokenizer 版本或 adapter 影响前向状态，前缀缓存身份必须覆盖相应条件；字符串相同只是其中一个投影。

## 输出流、停止字符串与终止

### 从 token 到字节

设普通 token v 对应的字节片段为 σ(v)。特殊 token、EOS、padding token 不应自动被当作可显示文本。整段解码可记为 D(ids[0:n])，它可能是字节级 BPE 的串接，也可能包含 tokenizer 规定的空格、清理或句子片段规则。因此逐 token 独立 decode 再串接未必等于整段 decode。

UTF-8 字符可以跨 token 和网络 chunk。例如字符“你”的 UTF-8 字节是 E4 BD A0；某些 byte-fallback 或字节级 tokenizer 可能把这三个字节分到不同 token。若每个 token 都用替换字符解码，流式输出就会丢字或乱码。合法实现必须保留不完整字节，直到形成完整字符。

增量解码的充分条件不是“tokenizer 可分块”，而是 decoder 对当前已知前缀和实际未来扩展具有可证明的保持关系。若清理空格、去除特殊 token 或后处理会改变已经发出的前缀，就不能提前提交这些字节；应延迟到稳定边界，或重新解码并保留可撤回状态。

### stop string 的状态机

stop string 可能跨多个 token 或多个网络 chunk。若协议规定停止字符串不展示给用户，就不能先发出可能构成其前缀的字符再撤回。设已产生的解码文本字节为 candidate，已经释放给协议层的字节数为 released。每次 append 后，要在 candidate 中寻找所有 stop string 的最早出现位置；没有命中时，只释放那些不可能成为某个 stop string 前缀的后缀。

```pseudocode
ALGORITHM StreamText
状态：candidate 字节串、released、stopped、reason、stop_name
输入：decoder 产出的普通文本字节 piece，停止字符串集合 P
输出：本次可以提交的文本，或停止事件

Feed(piece):
    if stopped: 返回空串
    candidate ← candidate ∥ piece
    hit ← candidate 中按开始位置最早、同位置按最长匹配选出的 P 元素
    if hit 存在:
        cut ← hit.start                    若协议排除停止字符串
        cut ← hit.start + |hit|            若协议包含停止字符串
        text ← candidate[released:cut] 中可形成完整 UTF-8 字符的最长前缀
        released ← released + |text|
        stopped ← true；reason ← stop；stop_name ← hit
        返回 text
    keep ← candidate 中最长的、同时是某个 P 元素真前缀的后缀
    safe ← |candidate| − |keep|
    text ← candidate[released:safe] 中可形成完整 UTF-8 字符的最长前缀
    released ← released + |text|
    返回 text

Finish():
    if stopped: 返回空串
    text ← candidate[released:|candidate|] 中完整的 UTF-8 前缀
    若仍剩不完整字节，返回 FAILED_INCOMPLETE_UTF8
    stopped ← true；reason ← eos
    返回 text
```

这里的“真前缀”很关键：完整 stop 已经命中就必须停止；只命中前缀时只能保留后缀，不能把它当普通文本发出。候选停止串 `ab` 和 `abc` 在同一位置开始时，排除停止串的输出前缀相同，但记录的最长匹配和 finish reason 可能不同；实现必须预先规定同位置规则。

EOS、达到最大输出 token 数和命中 stop string 是不同终止原因。EOS 是模型特殊事件，不应作为普通文本展示；stop string 是协议层后处理条件；最大 token 数是预算终止。若生成内容中包含 EOS 文本样式但模型没有产生 EOS token，不能把二者混同。

## 成本与条件化选择

模板渲染、规范化和 tokenization 都是主机侧工作。设输入原始字节数为 B，有效 token 数为 n，模板渲染成本为 C_T(M)，tokenizer 成本为 C_K(B)，则一次输入准备的主要成本可写成 C_T(M)+C_K(B)+O(n) 的映射与校验工作。tokenizer 的成本不一定与 B 线性，BPE 合并、正则和 native 实现都会改变常数；只能按实际实现测量，不能把 token 数当作 CPU 时间的充分统计量。

若服务到达率为 λ，单请求 tokenization 平均消耗 c_tok CPU 秒，则只考虑该阶段时，稳定性必要条件为 λc_tok < p_eff，其中 p_eff 是实际可用的有效核数。例如 λ=1000 请求/秒、c_tok=2 ms，则仅 tokenization 就需要 2 CPU 秒/秒，至少相当于 2 个有效核，尚未计排队、分词方差和其他主机工作。这个条件只说明长期负载是否超过资源，不保证尾延迟。

输出侧设解码文本总字节数为 D，停止字符串总长度为 L，最长停止字符串字节长度为 W。用简单的后缀检查实现时，最坏可写成 O(DW)；预先构造多模式自动机后，构建成本 O(L)，在线扫描可接近 O(D+命中数)，但仍要为每个请求保留状态和输出缓冲。无论哪种实现，未释放文本的驻留上界至少包含 W−1 字节的停止前缀窗口，以及最多 3 个不完整 UTF-8 字节；若 decoder 还要求重做清理，缓冲可能更大。

用户看到首段文本的时间可概念性地写成：排队与准入、模板和 tokenization、调度、prefill、首个 token 采样、decoder 与停止窗口的串行部分。只有确实位于同一关键路径的项才能相加；可重叠的主机准备与设备执行应取依赖后的时间，不能把各自耗时直接求和。若输出开头恰好是长停止串的前缀，停止窗口会延迟首段可见文本；这不是整个响应都被延迟，而是最多与 W 有关的待确认后缀。

当模型 prefill 和 decode 已占主导时，优化 tokenization 可能只降低主机 CPU 占用而不改变用户时延；当 CPU 输入阶段成为瓶颈时，应把模板渲染、tokenization 和输出编码放进有界执行域，并分别记录排队时间与服务时间。分词缓存必须把模板、tokenizer 版本、特殊 token 策略和原始内容纳入键；只缓存 UI 字符串会制造错误复用。

## 条件变化后的调整

模板或 tokenizer 版本改变时，旧的 token ID、偏移和前缀缓存身份不能继续使用。即使词表大小相同，token 到字节的映射和特殊 token 规则也可能变化；输出 decoder 必须随输入制品一起切换。工具调用格式或多模态 processor 改变时，也应重新检查消息边界、placeholder 顺序和位置元数据。

输入可以增量到达时，只有稳定前缀契约成立才适合边到边分词并推进模型前缀。若规范化或 BPE 合并不保证前缀稳定，应保留原始字节并在稳定边界重做，或等完整输入后再构造模型输入。选择增量路径的代价是更复杂的缓冲和失败处理；选择整段路径的代价是首 token 等待更长，但语义更容易证明。

停止字符串很多或很长时，应使用多模式匹配和固定的同位置规则；若模式数量很少、输出很短，简单实现可能更容易审计。若协议允许包含停止字符串，释放窗口和 finish reason 要重新定义；不能在流开始后根据某个客户端临时改变是否展示停止串。

多模态输入还要把图片/音频内容、processor 版本、采样率、裁剪和 patch 网格纳入身份。文本 placeholder 相同不代表视觉特征相同；媒体 URL 相同也不代表内容未变化。输出音频还需要样本位置、编码格式和 chunk 顺序，不能套用文本 UTF-8 边界。

## 诊断与区分实验

| 观察 | 竞争解释 | 区分实验 |
|---|---|---|
| 两段显示相同的文本得到不同输出 | 模板不同、tokenizer 版本不同、特殊 token 重复、截断不同 | 固定模型与采样，分别比较渲染字节、ids、特殊 token 位置和 removed_spans；只比较最终字符串不能排除任一解释 |
| 流式输出少字或出现替换字符 | 逐 token 解码、UTF-8 边界错误、decoder 版本不匹配 | 用整段字节解码作独立参考，把同一字节串按不同 chunk 切分；负对照故意逐 token 解码并忽略错误 |
| 停止字符串前缀泄漏 | 未保留后缀、匹配发生在 token 内部而不是文本边界、先发后撤 | 用跨 token 的 stop 前缀，比较排除停止串的最终字节和每个中间释放点；负对照立即 flush 所有 token |
| padding 后取错 logits | 无条件取最后一列、mask 或 positions 错误 | 右 padding 与左 padding 使用不同有效长度，独立计算最后一个有效索引；负对照固定取 L_pad−1 |
| finish reason 或 usage 不一致 | EOS、stop、长度预算被混用，停止串被排除但 token 已采样 | 构造 EOS 与 stop 紧邻、stop 跨三个 token、达到长度上限的样例，分别记录采样数、解码数和交付数 |
| 多轮缓存命中却语义变化 | 模板回合标记、工具结果格式或多模态身份未进入缓存键 | 相同用户文本配不同模板/工具顺序，比较最终模型输入和前缀身份；字符串相同只作为负对照 |

The most useful negative controls deliberately break one semantic relation while preserving format. For example, a detokenizer can produce valid UTF-8 and plausible text while dropping one split multi-byte character; a stop detector can produce the right final substring while leaking a prefix before the stop is confirmed; a padding reader can return a real logit row but from a padding position. These failures should be rejected by an oracle that compares logical bytes, token identity, or valid-position indices, not by merely checking that a response exists.

class StopStream:
    def __init__(self, stops, include_stop=False):
        if not stops:
            raise ValueError('at least one stop')
        self.stops = [bytes(s) for s in stops]
        self.include_stop = include_stop
        self.candidate = bytearray()
        self.released = 0
        self.stopped = False
        self.finish_reason = None
        self.stop_string = None

    def _earliest(self):
        best = None
        for s in self.stops:
            p = self.candidate.find(s)
            if p < 0:
                continue
            key = (p, -len(s), s)
            if best is None or key < best[0]:
                best = (key, p, s)
        return best

    def _release_to(self, limit):
        if limit <= self.released:
            return ''
        n = limit
        while n > self.released:
            try:
                self.candidate[:n].decode('utf-8')
                break
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                n -= 1
        if n <= self.released:
            return ''
        text = bytes(self.candidate[self.released:n]).decode('utf-8')
        self.released = n
        return text

    def _keep_len(self):
        keep = 0
        m = len(self.candidate)
        for s in self.stops:
            top = min(len(s) - 1, m)
            for k in range(top, 0, -1):
                if self.candidate.endswith(s[:k]):
                    if k > keep:
                        keep = k
                    break
        return keep

    def feed(self, piece):
        if self.stopped:
            return ''
        if not isinstance(piece, (bytes, bytearray)):
            raise TypeError('piece must be bytes')
        self.candidate.extend(piece)
        hit = self._earliest()
        if hit is not None:
            _, p, s = hit
            end = p + len(s) if self.include_stop else p
            text = self._release_to(end)
            self.stopped = True
            self.finish_reason = 'stop'
            self.stop_string = bytes(s).decode('utf-8')
            return text
        keep = self._keep_len()
        return self._release_to(len(self.candidate) - keep)

    def finish(self):
        if self.stopped:
            return ''
        text = self._release_to(len(self.candidate))
        if self.released < len(self.candidate):
            raise ValueError('incomplete utf-8 at finish')
        self.stopped = True
        self.finish_reason = 'eos'
        self.stop_string = None
        return text


class FaultyStream:
    def feed(self, piece):
        return piece.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')

    def finish(self):
        return ''


def oracle(pieces, stops, include_stop=False):
    data = b''.join(pieces)
    best = None
    for s in stops:
        p = data.find(s)
        if p < 0:
            continue
        key = (p, -len(s))
        if best is None or key < best[0]:
            best = (key, p, s)
    if best is not None:
        _, p, s = best
        end = p + len(s) if include_stop else p
        return data[:end].decode('utf-8'), 'stop', s.decode('utf-8')
    return data.decode('utf-8'), 'eos', None


def segmentations(parts):
    if not parts:
        yield []
        return
    for i in range(1, len(parts) + 1):
        head = b''.join(parts[:i])
        for rest in segmentations(parts[i:]):
            yield [head] + rest


def run_stream(parts, stops, include_stop=False):
    stream = StopStream(stops, include_stop)
    chunks = []
    for seg in parts:
        chunks.append(stream.feed(seg))
    chunks.append(stream.finish())
    return ''.join(chunks), stream.finish_reason, stream.stop_string


def check_case(name, pieces, stops, include_stop=False):
    expected = oracle(pieces, stops, include_stop)
    checked = 0
    for segs in segmentations(pieces):
        got = run_stream(segs, stops, include_stop)
        checked += 1
        if got != expected:
            return False, name, expected, got, checked
    return True, name, expected, expected, checked


def last_valid_index(mask):
    for i in range(len(mask) - 1, -1, -1):
        if mask[i]:
            return i
    raise ValueError('no valid position')


def render(messages, add_generation_prompt=False, continue_final_message=False):
    if add_generation_prompt and continue_final_message:
        raise ValueError('mutually exclusive')
    out = []
    for i, item in enumerate(messages):
        role, content = item
        out.append('<' + role + '>')
        out.append(content)
        last = i == len(messages) - 1
        if not (continue_final_message and last):
            out.append('</' + role + '>')
    if add_generation_prompt:
        out.append('<assistant>')
    return ''.join(out)


def main():
    print('scope: CPU logical check of tokenization, padding and streaming stop semantics')
    failures = []

    cases = []
    cases.append(('stop-cross-token', [b'he', b'llo', b' W', b'ORLD', b' tail'], [b'WORLD'], False))
    cases.append(('utf8-split-no-stop', [b'caf', bytes([0xC3]), bytes([0xA9]), b' ok'], [b'ZZZ'], False))
    cases.append(('utf8-and-stop', [b'caf', bytes([0xC3]), bytes([0xA9]), b' hello', b'WORLD', b'tail'], [b'helloWORLD'], False))
    cases.append(('emoji-split', [bytes([0xF0]), bytes([0x9F]), bytes([0x98]), bytes([0x80]), b'!'], [b'NO'], False))
    cases.append(('earliest-longest-tie', [b'x', b'abc', b'y'], [b'ab', b'abc'], False))
    cases.append(('unfinished-prefix-at-finish', [b'x', b'he'], [b'hello'], False))
    cases.append(('stop-at-start', [b'WORLD', b'tail'], [b'WORLD'], False))
    cases.append(('empty-stream', [], [b'STOP'], False))
    cases.append(('include-stop-policy', [b'he', b'llo', b' W', b'ORLD', b' tail'], [b'WORLD'], True))

    for name, pieces, stops, include_stop in cases:
        ok, case_name, expected, got, checked = check_case(name, pieces, stops, include_stop)
        if ok:
            print('PASS case', case_name, 'partitions', checked)
        else:
            print('FAIL case', case_name, 'expected', expected, 'got', got)
            failures.append(case_name)

    faulty_case = [b'caf', bytes([0xC3]), bytes([0xA9]), b' hello', b'WORLD', b'tail']
    expected_text = oracle(faulty_case, [b'helloWORLD'])[0]
    faulty = FaultyStream()
    faulty_text = ''.join(faulty.feed(p) for p in faulty_case) + faulty.finish()
    if faulty_text == expected_text:
        print('FAIL negative control was not detected')
        failures.append('negative-control-stream')
    else:
        print('PASS negative control detected: faulty stream changed bytes')

    mask_right = [1, 1, 1, 0]
    mask_left = [0, 1, 0]
    if last_valid_index(mask_right) != 2:
        failures.append('right-padding-last-valid')
    else:
        print('PASS right padding last valid index 2')
    if last_valid_index(mask_left) != 1:
        failures.append('left-padding-last-valid')
    else:
        print('PASS left padding last valid index 1')
    bad_index = len(mask_left) - 1
    if bad_index == last_valid_index(mask_left):
        print('FAIL negative control did not distinguish -1 from mask')
        failures.append('negative-control-padding')
    else:
        print('PASS negative control detected: last column is not last valid')

    messages = [('system', 'S'), ('user', 'U')]
    expected_render = '<system>S</system><user>U</user><assistant>'
    got_render = render(messages, add_generation_prompt=True)
    if got_render != expected_render:
        print('FAIL template render mismatch')
        failures.append('template-render')
    else:
        print('PASS template generation prompt rendered once')

    try:
        render(messages, add_generation_prompt=True, continue_final_message=True)
        print('FAIL template conflict was not rejected')
        failures.append('template-conflict')
    except ValueError:
        print('PASS template conflict rejected')

    if failures:
        print('FAILURES', ','.join(failures))
        return 1
    print('PASS: all scoped CPU checks passed; no GPU or real model was measured')
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
